<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def g(fr,r0,c0):
    L=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(1 if L[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def show(gy): return '\n'.join(''.join('#' if x else '.' for x in row) for row in gy)
cur=current_frame
S1=g(cur,41,22)
start=g(cur,52,22)
print("start P1:",show(start).replace('\n','|'))
states=[start]
# cycle UP up to 14 times, stop if back to start or matches S1
for k in range(14):
    action(['UP'])
    cur=current_frame
    st=g(cur,52,22)
    states.append(st)
    tag=""
    if st==start: tag="==START (cycle len %d)"%(k+1)
    if st==S1: tag+=" MATCHES S1!"
    print(f"UP{k+1}:",show(st).replace('\n','|'),tag)
    if st==start or st==S1:
        break
print("total states recorded:",len(states))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
